title: FENWICK ROAD COMMUNITY GARDEN: ANNUAL PLOT LICENCE
summary: This is a one-season licence for a single plot at the Fenwick Road community garden, at a flat forty-five dollars paid once before 1 March. The plot holder agrees to keep the plot planted, keep the paths clear and use no synthetic pesticide. The association agrees to keep the water running, mow the paths, restock the shed and give notice before anyone needs access across the plot. Either side can end the licence on thirty days written notice, and it stops on 30 November rather than renewing, so next season means applying again.
